_model_notes: Urea screening: net Bosch-Meiser stoichiometry at specified 60% single-pass conversion; gas recovery and evaporation are specified component separations. Carbamate equilibrium and industrial NH3/CO2 recycle are not modeled. Separate liquid-ammonia pumping (12 to150bar) and four-stage CO2 compression with intercooling replace the invalid mixed liquid/gas compressor. CO2 is condensed at25C/150bar before mixing. Reactor heat recovery and explicit letdown valves feed the20bar gas separator and1bar evaporator. Machine calorics remain the engine screening approximation.
